sentences.text: Pharmacy technicians prepare and fill prescriptions, assist pharmacists, manage inventory, and may process insurance claims; they often stand or walk during the workday.
Manteca listings include pharmacy technician openings at Walmart and a retail location; a Walgreens apprenticeship is listed in nearby Tracy.
Walgreens offers an earn-while-you-learn apprenticeship to help trainees become certified through the PTCB.
